## Current delivery contract — user-approved two-outcome stack
Owner: PR B. One PR per complete outcome, NOT one PR per bead. Keep detailed beads and cohesive internal commits for tracking; consolidate existing draft foundations into their owning feature PR where practical. PR B stacks on independently usable PR A. Include owning PR documentation and validation there. This supersedes earlier per-bead/prerequisite PR instructions and historical comments. Closed foundation status is not outcome acceptance.
New-feature E2E requires explicit human UX approval in zaq-emb.32; no self-approval.

## Functional specifications
Extend RequestTransformer/HistoryLoader and Factory/ServerManager rather than background fanout. Keep person-bound scopes and repair steering correlation. Tests through real multi-turn Jido execution: A then A+B, no duplicate original/steered input, tool pairs preserved, fixed cursor, multi-transcript cursor isolation, attachment of old messages, concurrently committed associations, budget pressure, failed reads, sync failure, replacement incarnation and next-request race. Verify request-local projections and completed context agree.

SUPERSEDES: background steer/inject broadcast to all active agents. Each runtime pulls authorized cumulative deltas before internal model turns with a fixed cursor. Cursor is per transcript association stream, not message creation timestamp.

## Files and ownership
lib/zaq/agent/context_window/request_transformer.ex; history_loader.ex; api.ex; executor.ex; request_registry.ex; related integration tests

## Action reuse assessment
Reuse RequestTransformer before each model call and HistoryLoader/Engine authorized reads; no background inject/fanout subsystem. Preserve Jido steer only for same-Person explicit inputs. Boundary synchronization is a dedicated child.

## Tests to add before implementation / branches
Use the explicit scenarios in Functional specifications as acceptance tests; include denial, failure, concurrency and idempotency branches where applicable. Preserve existing passing assertions.

## Mocking plan
External transport/model/clock boundaries only; no blanket NodeRouter stubs.

## Documentation
docs/services/agent.md; transformer/history contracts

Execution requirements: planning only until assigned for implementation. Preserve existing uncommitted work and progress comments; do not infer completion from historical tests. Read AGENTS.md, docs/agent-tools.md, docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md, docs/action-reuse.md, docs/testing-approach.md and applicable service guides before affected work. Write immediate unit/integration/property regression tests BEFORE implementation. Mock only genuine external boundaries; keep internal domain paths real. Run isolated tests and mix q per issue; final precommit belongs to the dedicated final gate. New feature E2E authoring waits for zaq-emb.32. No commit/push authorization is implied.

## Alignment update — 2026-10-07 / a0c8796e
Batch bounded authorized reads per transcript/source and test query growth across internal turns. Keep one cursor per association stream; cached capture validation is not read authorization. Complete recipient evidence survives model-budget trimming; original/steered input and tool pairs stay deduplicated. Test a root absent initially and captured later at a new association position: include it once without resetting/skipping cursors or relying on its older provider timestamp.

Preserve baseline contracts and committed test suites in zaq-emb.30; extend coverage rather than duplicating it. Tests precede production changes; no status change or completion is asserted. .30 owns steering admission/disposition; this issue owns per-turn refresh, not a parallel steering implementation.

comments.text: Refresh groundwork: extend existing Conversations.execution_history/2 as /3 with after_cursors; reuse TranscriptHistory.list/3 exact-source authorization/sanitization/association ordering. Repeated reads are idempotent and never update runtime state. Consumers: existing NodeRouter :execution_history dispatch, then RequestTransformer/HistoryLoader integration; boundary sync remains .16. Per-turn wire integration, old-message association/concurrent bounds, failed reads/budget and lifecycle synchronization remain pending; this is not completion of .5.

Committed ec33764f Engine delta groundwork and c11199cc first per-turn integration. Executor forwards original admission/fixed initial cursors with trusted actor/router/scope through existing Factory tool_context; RequestTransformer confidentially reads cumulative deltas every internal call and HistoryLoader merges request-local canonical UUID entries, preserving system/history/current input/tool exchange and excluding retained consumed steering. Real provider/Jido continuation regression first failed on missing passive A, now verifies exact old prefix, added factual rejected/failed-persistence inputs + attributed A, exact original current question and tool call/result/one correction. Acceptance uses explicit 20k model window to keep those exact retention assertions; existing pressure tests unchanged. Merge identity/purity property and real independent-connection blocked history read -> safe history_unavailable -> reusable old cursor covered. DB failure normalization stays in Engine, not Agent/provider logic. Latest 211 tests +5 properties +6 doctests, mix q/diff/hooks passed. ExDNA had one transient 5s detection timeout; unchanged rerun and commit hook passed. Still in_progress: true three-turn A then A+B wire acceptance, late old-message attachment/concurrent captured bounds, additional denial/budget/read and page-consumer audits; .16 owns warm cursor/context sync and race/replacement gates, not yet implemented. No publication.

Three-turn wire companion committed 60e81f0e. Real provider/Engine/Jido/registered arithmetic tools execute two successive tool calls with external HTTP barriers: initial request no delta; second A once/no B; third A+B once each, exact original system/current input, chronological attributed additions and exact two correlated call/result pairs. One completed private execution, actual 15/3 usage and one public answer; passive notes do not create receipts or transfer authority. Latest 84 tests +4 properties and mix q/diff/hooks green; prior expanded integration 211 +5 properties +6 doctests green. Outstanding .5 audit remains late association of old canonical content, concurrently committed associations/captured uppers, page-consumer and pressure/denial during a real multi-turn run. .16 context/incorporated cursor synchronization remains separately pending. Local commits only, no new product decision or publication.

Association/grant audit committed 5c206664. prepare_capture creates canonical content before request with 2020 provider timestamp; later ordinary capture attaches same UUID after fixed C and delta includes it without altering old row. Independent actual DB reader pauses after its transcript/association snapshot; writer admits/commits a fresh association on another connection; first bounded read excludes it and returns original upper/C, next read sees it. UUID-scoped extra execution cleanup registered before assertions; no sleeps/internal mocks. Real provider/Jido tool run revoked during first external LLM barrier produces no second LLM request and failed private root/no canonical answer while retaining factual input. Latest 87 tests +4 properties, mix q/diff/hooks green. Remaining .5: explicit refreshed budget/page-consumer audit and comprehensive preservation; .16 still owns warm boundary synchronization/incarnation and admission races. No publication.
